palette.$description: The ink-mint palette («Чорнильна мʼята», the engineer, 2026-10-22, docs/ui-decisions.md, pages/suit-final/): calm neutrals, one accent and the danger colour. An entry marked (agent) is a shade the agent derived inside the palette for a state.

base.$description: The base: the ground of the full screens, a bar's or a pip's empty track, a field's cell, the map board.

module.$description: The module: the fill of every tile (the plain tile, «Плитка»): HUD tiles, panels, cards, slots.

row.$description: A row face on a tile: a list row, a secondary button, a key, a segment, a dropdown; the hover fill of a quiet control.

row-light.$description: (agent) A row face lifted: the hover face of a row-faced control.

edge.$description: The edge: a tile's 2 px outline, a setting row's divider, a key's edges.

text.$description: Text, and the second pip colour (stamina).

dim.$description: Dim text: labels, values, the calm anger fill.

accent.$description: The mint accent: the main action, the chosen segment, the own name, health, focus rings, the aliens' band.

accent-light.$description: (agent) The accent lifted: the main action's hover face.

accent-dark.$description: (agent) The accent pressed: the main action's held face.

accent-deep.$description: The deeper accent: the main action's 5 px bottom edge.

accent-ink.$description: The accent ink: text on an accent face.

danger.$description: The danger colour: the loud moments (the cops, a human's reveal, the humans' and the cops' ends), alarms, the human tag.

danger-light.$description: (agent) The danger colour lifted: a danger button's hover face.

danger-dark.$description: (agent) The danger colour pressed: a danger button's held face.

danger-deep.$description: The deeper danger: the 5 to 8 px bottom edge of a danger face, the map pin's outline.

danger-ink.$description: The danger ink: text on a danger face.

white.$description: White: icons and dots the game tints by multiplying (self_modulate), the crosshair.

shade.$description: The halo of text on the world (a name over a head, the bare timer) and the crosshair's ring: near-black at 75 % (the target's world plates).

backdrop.$description: (agent) The base at 87 % over the world behind the suit menu: the target's .dim is 50 % over a dark ship, but light and dim text must keep 4.5:1 over a white world (the contrast gates).

backdrop-deep.$description: (agent) The base at 90 % over the world behind a dialog.

zone.$description: (agent) A lit zone on the map: the accent at 30 %.

text.$description: Text and every smaller title: Onest (the engineer, 2026-10-22).

number.$description: Numbers (the time, counts, prices, codes): Unbounded, as the target page sets them.

logo.$description: The display face (the name kept from ui-1.0.0): Unbounded, for the loud titles, the titles, the logo and the tiles' kickers.

medium.$description: Text and names (Onest Medium, as the target page sets its rows' names).

semibold.$description: Rows and buttons on the target page that are not bold.

bold.$description: Bold text, numbers, titles (Onest Bold) and the display face (Unbounded Bold).

wide.$description: The kickers' capitals (the target's 1 px at 8 px x 1.5, rounded up).

line-height.$description: Each family's own line box, (ascender + descender) / units per em from its file: Godot 4.7.2 draws a line as the ascent plus the descent, each rounded up to a pixel, with no line gap. The build checks each against fonts/ (B04) once the files are there; until then the values come from the font records' expected metrics (fonts/<family>/LICENCES.json, unconfirmed).

base.$description: The text, Onest: (970 + 305) / 1000 (the ui-1.0.0 name kept).

press.$description: The CSS image of Godot's TRANS_SINE + EASE_OUT (Tween has no cubic-bezier).

focus.$description: Keyboard and gamepad focus ring: an accent ring of 3 px (the target's 2 px x 1.5), 3 px of the ground between it and the face when it sits outside.

stroke.$description: The plain tile's lines at the 1920x1080 frame: the target page's 1280x720 lengths x 1.5, rounded up (its 1 px edge is 2 px here).

thin.$description: Bar tracks, dividers and small marks.

control.$description: The edge or outline of a control.

selected.$description: The outline of the chosen or active thing (the hand in use, the chosen card, the tab underline): the target's 2 px x 1.5.

bold.$description: A key's bottom edge: the target's 3 px x 1.5, rounded up.

edge.$description: A bright button's deeper bottom edge: the target's 3 px x 1.5, rounded up.

halo.$description: The shade halo around text on the world (Godot's shadow outline): the target's 4 px x 1.5.

alarm.$description: A loud tile's deeper bottom edge (the cops): the target's 5 px x 1.5, rounded up.

screen.$description: The danger edge around the whole screen in the cops' minute: the target's 8 px x 1.5.

radius.$description: Small corners (the plain tile): the target page's radii x 1.5.

space.$description: The separations of the screens' rows, columns and grids (the only gaps a screen uses).
